response.sql: WITH matched_transactions AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM transactionrecord t INNER JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON t.transreg = ab.translink INNER JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), unique_transactions AS (SELECT DISTINCT transreg FROM matched_transactions), unique_trader_types AS (SELECT DISTINCT tradekind FROM matched_transactions), total_combinations AS (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS total FROM unique_transactions, unique_trader_types), trans_type_combos AS (SELECT ut.transreg, utt.tradekind, CASE WHEN mt.transreg IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS count, (CASE WHEN mt.transreg IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / (SELECT total FROM total_combinations) AS share FROM unique_transactions ut CROSS JOIN unique_trader_types utt LEFT JOIN matched_transactions mt ON ut.transreg = mt.transreg AND utt.tradekind = mt.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, AVG(count * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM trans_type_combos GROUP BY tradekind
